items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: And then later on, through the years, he'd meet guys like Earl Palmer, Weedy Morris, and that's Edris Muhammad's brother. Yeah. Are you aware of Weedy? Yeah, I know. Yeah, I know. Okay, he died in St. Louis. You know, Chenu, Cornise, Coleman, Ed Blackwell.

ctx.x: All these guys. He was a drummer at the palace? He was a drummer at the palace.

He was a drummer at the palace. He was a drummer at the palace and at the rich. He said right in the front seat, as close as you and I, you know, he'd be playing. Then he used to tell me, he said, you can't do this, you know. But he was a man and I was a child. I said, I'm going to practice that, you know, not go home. We didn't have a practice pad. We made our own little practice pads. And all of this, you know, learning and being around these fellas. And then later on, through the years, he'd meet guys like…
Did he go with Hampton? Yeah.
